answer: The active Orders 4.0 schema renamed `orders.account_id` to `orders.buyer_account_id`; writers must use `buyer_account_id`, and `account_id` is no longer present. Incident evidence confirms the prepared statement still targets `orders(account_id, amount_cents)`, causing `column "account_id" of relation "orders" does not exist`, while a read-only catalog snapshot lists only `buyer_account_id`. The v3.1 runbook is superseded and its rollback window closed on 2026-07-13 02:00 UTC, so diagnosis must be read-only and no change is permitted.
